name: Acrobatics
description: Allows the user to perform feats of agility.

name: Analyze Aura
description: Allows the user to gain more information by Examining Aura.

name: Appraise
description: Allows the user to judge the monetary value of a normal item.

name: Assess
description: Allows the user to assess the worth or usefulness of an object

name: Awareness
description: Allows the user to notice motion and sounds in their vacinity.

name: Balance
description: Allows the user to remain standing when others may have fallen down.

name: Bluff
description: Allows the user to lie effectively.

name: Charge Device
description: Allows the user to power an array or item without being the creator, nor having skill with the required affinity.

name: Climb
description: Allows the user to ascend surfaces.

name: Deception
description: Allows the user to deceive others through disguise or smooth words.

name: Diplomacy
description: Allows the user to befriend a hostile creature.

name: Disable Device
description: Allows the user to disable the functionality of a mechanical device.

name: Disguise
description: Allows the user to take on a non-specific appearance that is not their own.

name: Imitate Appearance
description: Allows the user to mimic the appearance of another creature.

name: Escape Artist
description: Allows the user to escape from bonds.

name: Fly
description: Allows the user to perform complex feats of manual flight.

name: Forgery
description: Allows the user to produce a forged document.

name: Expertise
description: Allows the user to pull from a background knowledge.

name: Handle Animal
description: Allows the user to improve their relationship with and command animals.

name: Medical
description: Allows the user to assess a creature's health.

name: Identify
description: Allows the user to judge the properties of an aura infused item.

name: Intimidate
description: Allows the user to inspire fear in other creatures.

name: Investigation
description: Allows the user to obtain clues and piece together prior events.

name: Profession
description: Allows the user to perform a skillful trade.

name: Jump
description: Allows the user to leap through the air.

name: Open Lock
description: Allows the user to operate a mechanical lock without a key or combination.

name: Piloting
description: Allows the user to operate a flying vehicle.

name: Repair
description: Allow the user to repair mundane devices.

name: Search
description: Allows the user to locate valuable or useful items;

name: Sneak
description: Allows the user to remain unnoticed.

name: Contortion
description: Allows the user to contort their body to fit through small spaces or escape bindings

name: Performance
description: Allows the user to put on a show for the entertainment of others.

name: Judge
description: Allows the user to gain information about the personality of a humanoid target.

name: Construction
description: Allows the user to physically build things using a schematic.
